personal.name: Heera Lal
personal.title: Senior Data Scientist & AI Engineer
personal.tagline: Building production AI — GenAI, RAG pipelines, and agentic systems at scale
personal.bio: Senior Data Scientist with 5+ years building end-to-end ML systems at scale. Specialized in GenAI, RAG pipelines, and Agentic AI platforms. Published at IEEE ICDSAAI. Proven track record delivering production ML across e-commerce, insurance, and telecom.

experience.description: Enterprise AI — building the company's RAG and agentic AI platform.
highlights: Architected a data-source-agnostic ingestion pipeline supporting SharePoint, Jira, Confluence, Orbit, and custom sources, enabling seamless onboarding without platform-specific code changes.
Engineered a scalable vector database layer to index and retrieve from millions of documents with low-latency similarity search for enterprise knowledge management.
Built a hybrid retrieval system combining keyword (BM25) and semantic (dense embedding) search, improving answer relevance and recall across diverse query types.
Delivered an agentic chat platform via Chat UI, REST APIs, and SDK, enabling teams to build and scale AI-powered applications on the RAG infrastructure.

experience.description: AI Center of Excellence (AICoE) — production ML for large-scale e-commerce.
highlights: Designed a customer analytics platform for cohort curation enabling fraud detection, premium customer identification, and graph-based community detection.
Developed an intelligent information extraction system processing unstructured data (PDFs, images, text) using LLMs, significantly accelerating data extraction vs. manual workflows.
Implemented ML-driven trade discount optimization combining forecasting and constrained optimization, improving gross margins while meeting revenue targets.

experience.description: AI Center of Excellence (AICoE) — production ML for large-scale e-commerce.
highlights: Built an end-to-end return-prediction microservice for a large-scale e-commerce platform, forecasting return probability at item and cart levels; contributed to measurable reduction in return rates.

experience.description: Information Retrieval System — NLP for insurance documents.
highlights: Built an end-to-end information extraction pipeline from contractual emails using advanced NLP techniques, achieving 70%+ accuracy at launch.
Designed insurance entity extraction from contractual documents using YOLOv5, achieving 80%+ operational accuracy.
